missing_policy: complete required per score, otherwise null; product convention
source_note: GGSC Berkeley-hosted official form prints 12 items, reverse key (items 2, 6, 7) and 'sum values for items 1-12; higher values reflect greater mindful qualities' but no option anchor text. Anchors (1=rarely/not at all, 2=sometimes, 3=often, 4=almost always) corroborated verbatim from peer-reviewed open-access descriptions of the CAMS-R (Europe PMC PMC13059079; consistent with PMC13370295, PMC10779681); author's original form not consulted. Reverse formula for a 1-4 scale is min+max-response = 5-response. Score = sum of the 12 items after reversal (12-48); mean reported alongside. Any missing item yields null (complete_required, product-conservative convention, not an author rule); no norms or cutoffs are invented.
